scope: official v15 static evidence plus R01/R01b/R01c live evidence; no patch addresses inferred

external_side_effects: four helper calls driven by current tail 0x9c..0x9f
flag-dependent exchange between current +0x86/+0x87 and tail +0xa0/+0xa1

clean_mooger_negative_evidence.implication: A first-0x9c clone alone is not yet a credible fix for the R01c wrong-timbre failure. Tail/helper external state must be isolated or disproven with actual live capture.

designs.name: full UI Patch/runtime object clone then loader call
designs.source_destination_lifetime: Full object boundary, pointee ownership, and deep-copy lifetime are unknown. A shallow clone aliases live UI, synth, and storage objects.
designs.polyphony: Global/helper aliases can contaminate overlapping Ch1/Ch10 events. The 16 indexed dispatcher slots do not prove 16-note polyphony.
designs.note_off: The same cloned source/state generation would still be required for Note On and Note Off.
designs.ui_impact: High because loader and helpers are hardcoded to the live global object.
designs.code_cave: At least the approximately 0x180-byte loader plus helper adaptation and deep-clone RAM would be needed. No safe cave or RAM region is proven.

designs.name: existing loader loads a factory bank entry into a separate RAM object
designs.source_destination_lifetime: The existing loader has no destination argument and always overwrites the live current object. Dedicated RAM owner and preload lifetime are unknown.
designs.polyphony: An immutable self-contained source would be low risk, but self-containment is currently contradicted by the clean Mooger first-0x9c equality and R01c live failure.
designs.note_off: Any viable variant must use the identical Ch10 source/state generation for Note On and Note Off.
designs.ui_impact: Low only after a side-effect-free preload exists. Temporary live selection/load/restore is high impact and rejected.
designs.code_cave: No preload writer, owned RAM, or safe executable cave is proven.

designs.name: switch current object pointer or state at Note On
designs.source_destination_lifetime: A source-pointer switch is usable only if an independently valid immutable source exists. Global selection/loader state is shared and mutable.
designs.polyphony: Per-event global switching has the highest cross-channel race and release-order risk.
designs.note_off: Note-On-only switching is directly disproven by R01 stuck voice. Note Off must select the same source/state generation.
designs.ui_impact: Global state switching changes current Patch, helper state, and SAVE/SAVED-related behavior.
designs.code_cave: A source-only wrapper can be small, but its source producer is blocked. Save/load/restore and synchronization are not a minimal trampoline.

final_decision.reason: No design currently has a proven self-contained Ch10 timbre source, owned lifetime, and safe code cave.
next_proof: Capture actual live full 0xa3 current object immediately after stock target-Patch load.
Capture helper-updated external state and compare actual first 0x9c to the R01c/simulated hash.
If first 0x9c is equal, reject 0x9c-only clone and trace the external per-voice dependency.
Only after self-containment, RAM ownership, and safe cave proofs, route both Note On and Note Off to the same Ch10 source.
forbidden_now: Calling 0x02005660 in the Note hot path
Assigning any unproven RAM or executable address
Switching only Note On without matched Note Off
